title: Loop Body Configuration Extension
statement: Given a finite Boolean Turing machine $B$, a state $a$ of $B$, an input $x$, a configuration $c$ of $B$ on $x$, a Boolean release value $r$, and an optional Boolean flag value $f$, form a configuration for the loop-body machine with state obtained by pairing the state of $c$ with $r$. It keeps the input-head position, output, and all work tapes and head positions of $c$, and adds one work tape whose head is at position $0$ and whose only possibly nonblank cell is at position $0$, with contents $f$.
